rows.output: "Ìlọsíwájú ìwádìí AI lè jẹ́ ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ tó dára, níwọ̀n bí gbogbo orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn ti jìnnà gan-an sí orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà, a sì ń wá ìyípadà tó tẹ̀ lé e nínú AI," Lee sọ.

rows.output: Ìdá mẹ́ta ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lè mú kí àǹfààní pọ̀ sí i pé àṣeyọrí tó tóbi jù lọ nínú AI yóò ṣe ní U.S., Lee sọ fún CNBC nínú ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò kan ní ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá.
rows.reference: Sísọ ìfúnnilówó dí ìlọ́poméjì leè sọ àwọn ìṣọwọṣéeṣe náà di méjì láti ríi pé àṣeyọrí AI títóbi tókàn ní yóò di ṣíṣe ní orilẹ-ede U.S., gẹgẹ bíi Lee ṣe sọ fún CNBC ninu ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò kan lọ̣́̀sẹ́ yìí.

rows.output: Lee, tí ìwé rẹ̀ “AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley ati Aṣẹ́yìnnì Àgbáyé Tuntun” ti tẹ̀ jáde ní oṣù yìí nípasẹ̀ Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, jẹ́ olórí ilé-iṣẹ́ Sinovation Ventures, tí ó ti sọ owó sínú ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ AI tó gbajúmọ̀ jùlọ ní Ṣáínà, Face++.
rows.reference: Lee, ẹnití ìwé rẹ̀ ''AI Superpowers”: Orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà, Àfonífojì Silikọn ati Ààtò Ayé Tuntun'' ni wọ̀n ṣàgbéjáde lóṣù yìí láti ọwọ́ Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, tójẹ́ Olùdarí Àwọn Ìdókòòwò Sinovation, eyiti ó ti dókòòwò ninu ọ̀kan ninu àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ AI tó gbajú-gbajà ní orilẹ-ede Ṣáìnà, Face++.

rows.output: Ni awọn ọdun 1980 ni Ile-ẹkọ giga Carnegie Mellon, o ṣiṣẹ lori eto AI kan ti o lu oṣere Othello Amẹrika ti o ga julọ, ati nigbamii o jẹ alaṣẹ ni Iwadi Microsoft ati alaga ẹka China ti Google.
rows.reference: Ní àwọn ọdún 1980 sí 1989 ní Yunifásítì Carnegie Mellon ó ṣiṣẹ́ lórí ìlànà ètò àmúlòṣiṣẹ́ kan eyiti ó tayọ ti elére Othelo ti Amẹ́ríkà tówà lókè jùlọ, àtipé lẹ́yìn náà ó di aláṣẹ ti Ìwáàdí Microsoft àti ààrẹ ti ẹ̀ka Google ní orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà.

rows.output: Ó jẹ́wọ́ àwọn ìdíje imọ̀ ẹ̀rọ ìjọba orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà tẹ́lẹ̀ bíi Ìṣẹ́ Àtúnṣe Robotics Challenge ti Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, ó sì béèrè nígbà wo ni èyí tó tẹ̀ lé e yóò wáyé, láti ràn án lọ́wọ́ láti mọ àwọn onímọ̀ ẹ̀rọ tó ń bọ̀.
rows.reference: Lee ṣe ìdánimọ àwọn ìdíje ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ ti ìjọba orilẹ-ede U.S. bíi Ìpèníjà ti Àwọn Ẹ̀rọ Aláàdáṣiṣẹ́ ti Àjọ Àwọn Ìṣẹ́ Àkànṣe Ìwáàdí Tójinlẹ̀ nípa ààbò tí ó sì bèèrè igbati òmíràn tókàn jáde, láti leè ṣe ìrànwọ dídá àwọn eniyan oníran mọ̀.

rows.output: Àwọn onímọ̀ ẹ̀rọ ní orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà sábà máa ń ṣiṣẹ́ kára láti gba owó ìrànwọ́ ìjọba, Lee sọ.
rows.reference: Àwọn oní-ìwáàdí ní orilẹ-ede U.S. lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà níláti ṣiṣẹ́ takun-takun láti leè rí àwọn owó ìjọba gbà, ni Lee sọ.

rows.output: "Kò jẹ́ Ṣáínà ló ń gba àwọn aṣáájú ẹ̀kọ́ lọ́wọ́; ó jẹ́ àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ àárín." Lee sọ.

rows.output: Àwọn ìgbìmọ̀ ìjọba orílẹ̀-èdè Ṣáínà ṣe àtẹ̀jáde ètò ìdàgbàsókè fún ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ ìmọ̀ràn ọjọ́ iwájú ní oṣù Keje ọdún 2017.

rows.reference: Àjọ Ìmọ̀ Sáyẹ́ńsì fún Nǹkan Àtọ̀runwá ti Orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà ńpèsè owó fún àwọn eniyan ní àwọn ilé ẹ̀kọ́ ní ọ̀nà tó farajọ bí Àjọ Ìmọ̀ Sáyẹ́ńsì ti Orilẹ-ede àti àwọn àjọ miran ṣe ńfún àwọn oníṣẹ́-ìwáàdí orilẹ-ede U.S., ṣùgbọ́n ìṣọwọ́dára iṣẹ́ ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ wá nílẹ̀ lorilẹ-ede Ṣáínà, gẹgẹ bíi Lee ṣe sọ.

rows.reference: Níbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí orilẹ-ede U.S. Ẹ̀ka ti Ààbò ṣe ìdásílẹ̀ Ibùdó Ọpọlọ Àtọwọdá Alájọni kan, eyiti tó ní àwọn alájọ́ṣiṣẹ́pọ̀ láti ilé iṣẹ́ àti ilé ẹ̀kọ́ nínú, ti Ilé Ìjọba Funfun sì kéde ìṣẹ̀dá Ìgbìmọ̀ Àsàyàn lórí Ọpọlọ Àtọwọ́dá kan.

rows.output: Àwọn ará Macedonia ń dìbò lórí ìdìbò nípa bóyá láti yí orúkọ orílẹ̀-èdè náà padà
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ orilẹ-ede Macedonia ńdìbò ninu ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ lórí bóyá kí wọn yí orúkọ orilẹ̵-ede padà

rows.output: Àwọn ará Macedonia dìbò ní ìdìbò kan ní ọjọ́ Sunday lórí bóyá kí wọ́n yí orúkọ orílẹ̀-èdè náà padà sí “Orílẹ̀-èdè Àríwá Masedóníà,” ìgbésẹ̀ kan tí yóò yanjú ìforígbárí tó ti pẹ́ tó pẹ́ pẹ̀lú Gíríìsì tí ó ti dènà ìdìbò rẹ̀ fún Ìparapọ̀ Yúróòpù àti NATO.
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan Macedoni dìbò ninu ìbò oníbẹ́èni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ kan lọ́jọ́ Àìkú lórí bóyá kí wọ́n yí orúkọ rẹ̀ padà si ''Ilẹ̀ Olómìnira ti Àríwá Masidónià,'' ìgbésẹ kan tí yóò yanjú èdè-àìyedè atọdunmọdun kan pẹlu orilẹ-ede Gíríkì eyiti ó ti dínà mọ́ àwọn ìgbìyànjú rẹ̀ lati di ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Àjọ Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Yuroopu àti NATO.

rows.output: Gíríìsì, tí ó ní ìpínlẹ̀ kan tí wọ́n ń pè ní Masedonia, sọ pé orúkọ ìpínlẹ̀ aládùúgbò rẹ̀ ń fi ẹ̀tọ́ sí ilẹ̀ rẹ̀, ó sì ti dènà ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ rẹ̀ sí NATO àti EU.
rows.reference: Orilẹ-ede Gíríkì, eyiti ó ni ẹkùn tí a ńpè ni Masidóníà, ńtẹnumọ fún ìgbà pipẹ wípé orúkọ aláàmúlégbè òun ní ìhà àríwá ńdúró fun ṣíṣe bi olúwa lóri ilẹ̀ òun tí ó sì ti dìbò láti dínà mọ́ wíwọlé rẹ sínú àjọ NATO àti EU.

rows.output: Àwọn ìjọba méjì náà fọwọ́ sí àdéhùn kan ní oṣù kẹfà tí ó da lórí orúkọ tuntun tí a dámọ̀ràn, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn alátakò ẹ̀yà orílẹ̀-èdè ń jiyàn pé yíyí orúkọ padà yóò ba ìdánimọ̀ ẹ̀yà àwọn ará Macedonia tí wọ́n jẹ́ Slavic jẹ́.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìjọba méjèèjì náà ṣe àdéhùn kan ninu oṣù Òkúdu ní ìdúró lórí orúkọ tuntun náà tí wọn dá àbá rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọmọ orilẹ-ede tójẹ́ alátakò wí àwíjàre pé orúkọ náà yóò dín agbára ìdánimọ̀ àwọn ẹ̀yà Slavic ti Masidóníà tíwọ́n pọ̀ jùlọ kù.

rows.output: Ààrẹ Gjorge Ivanov ti sọ pé òun kò ní dìbò nínú ìdìbò náà, àwọn ìpolongo ìdìbò tí kò sí ti dín kù pé bóyá ìdìbò tó tó 50% tó yẹ kí ìdìbò náà jẹ́.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ Gjorge Ivanov ti sọpé òun kòní dìbò ninu ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ àtipé ìpolongo fún ìdẹ́yẹsí kan ti jẹ́kí àwọn ìsiyèméjì wà lórí bóyá ìjádedìbò yóò tó ìdá àádọ́ta ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún eyiti i ṣe iye tó kéré jùlọ tí wọ́n nílò fún ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà láti jẹ́ eyiti ó wúlò.

rows.output: Ìbéèrè tí wọ́n kọ sí káràkátà ìdìbò náà ni: "Ṣé o fẹ́ ìbáṣepọ̀ NATO àti EU pẹ̀lú ìfọwọ́sí àdéhùn pẹ̀lú Gíríìsì."
rows.reference: Ìbéèrè náà lóri ìwé àmútẹ̀kasí fún ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà kà báyìí: ''Ṣe o faramọ́ ìjọ́mọ-ẹgbẹ́ àjọ NATO àti EU pẹ̀lú ìtẹ́wọ́gbà ti àdéhùn náà pẹ̀lú orilẹ-ede Gíríkì.''.

rows.output: Àwọn olùfọkànsìn orúkọ yíyí, títí kan Ààrẹ Zoran Zaev, jiyàn pé ó jẹ́ owó tí ó tọ́ láti san láti lè lépa ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ sí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ bí EU àti NATO fún Masedonia, ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ó yọrí sí ìparun Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Àwọn alátìlẹyìn ti ìyípadà orúkọ náà, pẹ̀lú Adarí Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìjọba Zoran Zaev, wí àwíjàre wipe ó jẹ́ ìdíyelé tóyẹ kan láti san láti leè lépa ìgbaniwọlé sinu àwọn àjọ bíi EU àti NATO fún Masidóníà, ọ̀kan ninu àwọn orilẹ̀-ede tó yọ jáde síta láti inú ìwólulẹ̀ ti Orilẹ-ede Yugosilafia.

rows.output: Mo wá lónìí láti dìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orílẹ̀-èdè náà, fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Masedóníà kí wọ́n lè máa gbé láìsí ìbẹ̀rù lábẹ́ àpòòwé ti Ìparapọ̀ Yúróòpù nítorí pé ó túmọ̀ sí àwọn ìgbésí ayé tó dára jùlọ fún gbogbo wa,” ni Olivera Georgijevska, 79, sọ ní Skopje.
rows.reference: Mó wá lóòní láti di ìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orilẹ-ede náà, fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Masidóníà kí wọ́n leè máa gbé ní òmìnira lábẹ́ agboòrùn ti Àjọ Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Yuroopu nitoripe ó túmọ̀ sí àwọn ìgbésí ayé aláìléwu púpọ̀ síi fún gbogbo wa,'' gẹgẹ bíi Olivera Georgijevska, ẹni ọdún mọ́kàndínlọ́gọ́rin ṣe sọ, ní ìlú Skopje.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar, wacce a halin yanzu tana rubuta dokoki don gabatar da canje-canjen suna, ta ce: "Shawarar karshe kan duk wani bayanin abin da ake kira Majalisar Masu Zabe za ta kasance a hannun mambobin kansu ne."
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar, wanda a yanzu haka ke rubuta daftarin dokar don gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce:  “Hukuncin ƙarshe a kan kowaɗanne abubuwa masu bayyanarwa abin da ake kiran mambobi na Majalisar zai kasance kuwa wani batu ne don mambobin da kansu.”

rows.output: Dokar Gwamnatin Wales ta 2017 ta baiwa majalisar Welsh damar canza sunanta.

rows.output: A watan Yuni, Hukumar ta buga sakamakon wata tattaunawa ta jama'a kan shawarwarin da ta samu goyon baya mai fadi na kiran taron a matsayin Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.output: Game da taken AMs, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami goyon baya mafi yawa a cikin tattaunawa ta jama'a.
rows.reference: A kan batun sunan AMs ɗin, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi goyon bayan a cikin wata tattaunawar jama’a.

rows.output: Ana cewa AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu hanyoyi, amma gwagwarmayar cimma yarjejeniya na iya zama damuwa ga Shugaban Majalisa, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran zai gabatar da kudurin doka kan canje-canjen cikin makonni.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.output: Dokar gyaran kasa za ta hada da sauran gyare-gyare ga yadda majalisar ke aiki, ciki har da ka’idoji kan dakatar da mambobin majalisar da kuma tsarin tsarin kwamitocin.

rows.output: Mambobin za su sami karshe na kada kuri'a kan tambayar abin da za su kasance idan sun yi muhawara kan dokar.

rows.reference: Masu kada kuri’a za su yi zaɓe a kan ko su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Macedonia ta Arewa.”

rows.output: An kafa kuri'ar jama'a ne domin magance rikicin da ke tsakanin kasashen biyu, wanda ya shafi lardin da ake kira Macedonia.
rows.reference: An saita sanannen zaɓen ne don wani ƙoƙari na warware wani rikicin da ya yi shekara da shekara tare da makwaɓciyar ƙasa ta Greece, wadda ke da lardinta da ake kira Macedonia.

rows.output: Athens ta yi iƙirarin cewa sunan makwabtansu na arewa yana wakiltar ikirari kan ƙasarsu kuma sun yi adawa da neman su na shiga EU da NATO sau da yawa.
rows.reference: Athens ta jima tana jajircewa cewa sunan makwaɓciyarta daga arewaci yana wakiltar wani ƙorafi ne a kan yankinta kuma ta sha maimaita ƙin neman matsayin mamba a Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Shugaban Macedoniya Gjorge Ivanov, wanda ya kasance mai adawa da kuri'ar raba gardama kan canjin suna, ya ce ba zai yi la'akari da kuri'ar ba.
rows.reference: Shugaban Ƙasar Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, wani mai adawa da tsarin zaɓen kai tsaye a kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaɓen.

rows.output: Duk da haka, masu goyon bayan zaben, ciki har da Firayim Minista Zoran Zaev, sun yi gardama cewa canza sunan kawai kudin da za a biya don shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaɓen raba gardamar, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna mahawara cewa canza sunan wani ɗan aiki ne da dole a yi don a shiga Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: An dakatar da Agogon St. Martin yayin da coci-coci ke gwagwarmaya a Harlem
rows.reference: Ƙararrawar St. Martin's Sun yi Shiru Saboda Majami’u a cikin Harlem suna cikin Gwargwarmaya

rows.output: "A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kowane kusurwa," in ji Mista Adams.
rows.reference: “A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai wata mashaya da wata majami’a a kowace kusurwa,” Inji Mista Adams.

rows.output: "A yau, babu abin da ke akwai."
rows.reference: “A yau kuwa, babu ko ɗaya.”

rows.output: Ya ce rashin samun mashaya ya zama ruwan dare.
rows.reference: Ya ce ɓacewa ta mashayun abu ne na fahimta.

rows.output: "Mutane a yanzu suna mu'amala da juna ta hanyar da ta bambanta"
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.output: "An daina ganin gidajen giya a matsayin dakunan zama na unguwanni inda mutane ke zuwa akai-akai."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.output: Game da coci, yana damuwa cewa kudin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba zai dore ba kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani, "kuma ba da jimawa ba za su koma inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.output: Makarantun, in ji shi, za a iya maye gurbinsu da gine-ginen gidaje da aka cika da irin mutanen da ba za su taimaka wa sauran masallatan da ke cikin unguwar ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.output: "Yawancin mutanen da suke siyan gidajen kwana a cikin wadannan gine-gine za su kasance fari ne," ya ce, "sannan za su hanzarta rufewar wadannan coci-coci gaba daya domin ba zai yiwu a ce yawancin wadannan mutanen da za su koma wadannan gidajen kwana za su zama mambobin wadannan coci-coci ba."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.output: An gina cocin biyu ne ta hanyar al'ummar farare kafin Harlem ta zama babban birnin bakar fata - Cocin Al'umma a shekarar 1870, St. Martin a shekara goma daga baya.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.output: Jama'ar Methodist na asali sun bar a shekarun 1930.
rows.reference: Asalin farar fata mahalarta ‘yan Methodist sun fita ne a cikin shekaru na 1930.

rows.output: Jama'ar baki da suka yi ibada a kusa da su sun karbi mallakar ginin.
rows.reference: Wani taron masu ibada baƙaƙe da ke yin ibada a kusa suka mallaki ginin.

rows.output: An dauki Cocin St. Martin ta wata babbar al'umma ta bakar fata karkashin jagorancin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci yajin aikin da ya shafi shagunan da ke kan titin 125, babbar titin sayayya a Harlem, wadanda suka ki daukar ma'aikata ko kuma su kara musu albashi.
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.output: Wata gobara a shekarar 1939 ta yi barna sosai, amma yayin da mabiya cocin Father Johnson suka fara shirin sake gina ginin, sun ba da umarnin kararrawa.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.output: An jaddada Rev. David Johnson, ɗan Uba Johnson da magaji a St. Martin's, cewa carillon "ƙananan mutane ne."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.output: Ɗalibin da ya buga kararrawa a watan Yuli ya kira shi wani abu dabam: "Kasadar al'adu" da "na'urar tarihi marar maye."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.output: Ɗalibi, Tiffany Ng daga Jami'ar Michigan, ta lura cewa ita ce motar farko a duniya da 'yan wasan bakar fata suka yi wasa, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya koma babbar motar a Cocin Riverside shekaru 18 da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Kwararren, Tiffany Ng na Jami’ar Michigan, har ila yau ya lura cewa shi ne kayan kiɗa na farko a duniya da wani mawaki baƙar fata ya rera, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya motsa babban kayan kiɗan a Majami’ar Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.

rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's bai maye gurbinsa ba.

rows.output: A cikin watanni masu zuwa, labarin ya kasance mai rikitarwa na masu zanen kaya da masu aikin gini, wasu da shugabannin cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma ta cocin Episcopal.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.output: Majalisar cocin - wadda ta ƙunshi shugabannin da ba na addini ba, ta rubuta ga diocese a watan Yuli da damuwa cewa diocese "za ta yi ƙoƙarin watsa farashi" ga majalisar, duk da cewa majalisar ba ta shiga cikin daukar masu zanen kaya da masu gini da diocese ta aiko ba.

rows.output: Wasu mabiya cocin sun koka da rashin gaskiya a kan wajibcin cocin.

rows.output: Shirye-shiryen Sainsbury na shiga kasuwar kyau ta Burtaniya

rows.output: A matsayin wani bangare na babban tura cikin kasuwar kyau ta Burtaniya mai daraja £2.8bn, wanda ke ci gaba da girma yayin da sayar da kayan ado da kayan daki ke komawa baya, manyan kantunan kyau za a gwada a cikin shaguna 11 a fadin kasar, kuma a kai su cikin karin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan ya yi nasara.
rows.reference: A matsayin ɓangaren shiga cikin kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya ta Fam biliyan 2.8, wadda ke ci gaba da haɓaka duk da cewa cinikayyar ado da kayan gida ta sami koma baya, za a gwada manyan ɓangarorin kwalliya a shaguna 11 na kasar kuma a ɗauke su zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan abin ya ci wata nasara.

rows.output: Zuba jari a cikin kyawawan halaye ya zo ne yayin da manyan kantuna ke neman hanyoyin amfani da sararin samaniya da aka yi amfani da su a baya don talabijin, microwave, da kayan daki.
rows.reference: Zuba jari a harkar kwalliya yana zuwa ne kamar yadda manyan shagunan sayar da kaya ke fafutukar hanyoyi don yin amfani da gurbin da babu kome da a da na ajiye talabijoji ne, da na’urorin dafa abinci da kayan gida.

rows.output: Kamar yadda aka annabta, guguwar Rosa tana raunana yayin da take tafiya kan ruwan sanyi na bakin tekun arewa na Mexico.

rows.output: Duk da haka, Rosa za ta kawo ruwan sama mai yawa a arewacin Mexico da kudu maso yammacin Amurka a cikin kwanakin masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Amma, Rosa za ta haifar da ambaliyar ruwan sama a faɗin arewacin Mexico da kudu-maso-yamma na Amurka a kwanaki masu zuwa.

rows.output: Rosa ta yi guguwar kilomita 85 a cikin sa'a, wanda ya kai ga kungiyar 1, da misalin karfe 5 na safe a lokacin Gabas a ranar Lahadi, kuma tana tsakiyar kilomita 385 kudu maso yammacin Punta Eugenia, Mexico.
rows.reference: Rosa tana da iska ta mil 85 a cikin sa’a, wani Nau’i na 1 na Guguwar, a lokaci na ƙarfe 5 na safe a ranar Lahadi lokaci na Gabashi, kuma an gan ta a mil 385 na kudu-maso-yamma na Punta Eugenia, Mexico.

rows.output: Rosa za ta yi tafiya zuwa arewa a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin Rosa za ta motsa zuwa arewa a ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: A lokaci guda, wani rami yana fara bayyana a kan Tekun Pasifik kuma yana tafiya gabas zuwa gabar tekun Amurka. Yayin da Rosa ke gabatowa yankin Baja California a ranar Litinin a matsayin guguwar tropikal, za ta fara tura zurfin danshi na tropikal zuwa arewa zuwa yankin kudu maso yammacin Amurka.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake cikin nan, wata akalar ruwan ta fara kankama a saman Tekun Pacific inda ta motsa gabas zuwa Bakin Teku na Yamma na Amurka. Kamar yadda Rosa ke tunkaran zirin Baja California a ranar Litinin a matsayin wani babban haɗari za ta fara tura laimar zafi zuwa yankin arewaci cikin kudu-maso-yamma na Amurka.

rows.output: Rosa za ta kawo ruwan sama mai yawa har zuwa inci 10 a wasu sassan kasar Mexico a ranar Litinin.

rows.output: Sannan, danshi na wurare masu zafi yana mu'amala da giciyen da ke gabatowa zai haifar da ruwan sama mai yawa a duk fadin yankin Kudu maso Yamma a cikin 'yan kwanaki masu zuwa.

rows.output: A cikin gida, inci 1 zuwa 4 na ruwan sama zai haifar da ambaliyar ruwa mai hatsari, guguwar ƙwayoyin cuta, da yuwuwar ambaliya a cikin hamada.

rows.output: Zafin zafi mai zurfi zai sa yawan ruwan sama ya kai inci 2 zuwa 3 a kowace awa a wasu wurare, musamman a sassan kudancin Nevada da Arizona.

rows.output: Hakika ana iya samun ambaliyar ruwa mai karfi tare da yanayi mai sauri ya tabarbare saboda yanayin bazuwar ruwan sama na wurare masu zafi.

rows.output: Yana da matukar rashin hankali a yi tafiya cikin hamada da kafa tare da hadarin ruwan sama na wurare masu zafi.

rows.output: Tasirin rami zai kawo ruwan sama mai yawa a wasu sassan gabar tekun Kudancin California.

rows.output: Yawan ruwan sama da ya wuce rabin inci na iya haifar da ƙananan guguwa da hanyoyi masu sheki.

rows.output: Wannan zai zama farkon ruwan sama a wannan yanki a cikin damina.

rows.output: Oktoba na iya ganin wasu canje-canje masu tsanani na zafin jiki a fadin Amurka yayin da Arctic ke sanyaya, amma tropics na nan daram sosai.

rows.output: Yankin tsakiyar da gabashin Amurka na sa ran zai fara watan Oktoba da dumi tare da ruwan sama a fadin Kudancin Rana zuwa sassan Arewa maso Gabas.

rows.output: Birnin New York zai iya kaiwa digiri 80 a ranar Talata, wanda zai kasance kusan digiri 10 sama da matsakaici.

rows.output: Fiye da mutane miliyan 20 sun kalli shari'ar Brett Kavanaugh

rows.output: Fiye da mutane miliyan ashirin sun kalla shaidar da aka yi a ranar Alhamis tsakanin wanda aka zaba a kotun koli Brett Kavanaugh da kuma mace da ta zargi shi da cin zarafi, Christine Blasey Ford, a kan hanyoyin sadarwa guda shida.
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane miliyan 20 ne suka kalli shaida mai riƙewa daga wanda aka tura sunan don kujerar Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh da matar da ke ƙararsa a kan cin zarafi na jima’i da ake cewa ya faru a cikin shekaru na 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, a kan hanyoyin sadarwar gidajen talabijin guda shida.

rows.output: A lokaci guda, rikicin siyasa ya ci gaba da gudana, inda masu watsa shirye-shirye suka katse shirye-shiryen yau da kullun don kammala minti na karshe na ranar Juma'a: yarjejeniya da dan majalisar dattawan Arizona Jeff Flake ya shirya domin hukumar binciken tarayya ta gudanar da bincike na mako guda kan zarge-zargen.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake cikin haka, rikicin siyasar ya ci gaba, tare da masu yada labarai suna katsse shirin da ake yi na kullum don wani sauyi da aka yi na ranar Jumu’a a makare: wata yarjejeniya da Sanatan Arizona Jeff Flake ya haifar don Hukumar FBI ta yi wani bincike na mako guda na tuhume-tuhumen.

rows.output: Ford ta gaya wa kwamitin shari'a na majalisar dattawa cewa tana da kashi 100 na tabbacin cewa an yi mata dukan tsiya kuma ta yi yunkurin cire mata kayanta a wani biki na makarantar sakandare.

rows.output: Kavanaugh, a cikin shaida mai ƙarfi, ya ce ba shakka 100 cewa bai faru ba.

rows.output: Wataƙila fiye da mutane miliyan 20.4 da Nielsen ya ruwaito a ranar Juma'a sun kalla.

rows.output: Kamfanin yana ƙididdige matsakaicin masu kallo a CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel da MSNBC.

rows.output: Tashar Fox News Channel, wadda ta goyi bayan ra'ayin shugabanninta na nadin Kavanaugh, ta jagoranci dukkan tashoshin da kashi 5.69 miliyan masu kallo a lokacin zaman gaba daya, a cewar Nielsen.

rows.output: An tattauna a cikin shirye-shiryen talabijin da na rediyo, sa'o'i da yawa bayan haka, lokacin da kwamitin shari'a zai kada kuri'a don ci gaba da takarar daftarin shawarar da majalisar dattijai ta yi wa kuri'a.

rows.output: Amma Flake ya ce hakan zai faru ne kawai idan hukumar ta FBI ta binciki zarge-zargen da ake yi wa dan takarar a cikin mako guda, wanda kungiyar ‘yan adawa ta Democrat ke nema.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, babban kocin kwallon kwando na Jami’ar Jihar Louisiana (LSU) Will Wade ya bayyana cewa kungiyar na “bacin rai” kuma “cikin kaduwa” saboda mutuwar Wayde.
rows.reference: A ranar Juma’a da safe, mai horar da ‘yan wasan ƙwallon kwandon na LSU Will Wade ya ce ƙungiyar ta sami “tashin hankali” da “girgiza” da mutuwar ta Wayde.

rows.output: "Wannan shine abin da kuke damuwa da shi a kowane lokaci," Wade ya ce.
rows.reference: “Wannan shi ne abin mutum yake damuwa game da shi a dukkan lokaci,” inji Wade.

rows.output: Wani tsauni ya zubar da ash a kan birnin Mexico
rows.reference: Babban dutsi mai amon wuta ya fesa toka a kan Birnin Mexico

rows.output: Gobarar da ke fitowa daga tsaunin Popocatepetl ta kai yankunan kudu na babban birnin kasar Mexico.
rows.reference: Toka da ke fesuwa daga babban dutsi mai amon wuta na Popocatepetl ta isa makwaɓta na kudancin babban birnin Mexico.

rows.output: Cibiyar Kasa da Kasa ta Gargaɗi game da Hana Bala'i ta gargadi 'yan ƙasar Mexico ranar Asabar da su kaurace wa tsaunin bayan da aka samu karuwar ayyukan a cikin kwarin kuma ya rubuta fitar da iskar gas da kura 183 a cikin sa'o'i 24.
rows.reference: Cibiyar Hana Haɗura ta Ƙasa ta gargaɗi ‘yan Mexico a ranar Asabar kar su kusanci dutsin bayan abin ya kai koli a farfashewar inda kuma a ka yi rijistar fitar da hayaƙi na iskar gas 183 da kuma toka ta fiye da sa’o’i 24.

rows.output: Cibiyar tana kallon abubuwa da yawa da girgizar kasa da girgizar kasa.
rows.reference: Cibiyar tana kula da cidodi da girgize-girgizen ƙasa.

rows.output: Hotuna a shafukan sada zumunta sun nuna yadda wani siririn toka ya rufe tagogin motoci a unguwanni kamar Xochimilco na birnin Mexico.
rows.reference: Hotuna a hanyar sadarwa ta zumunta sun nuna mashimfiɗu marassa kauri na toka suna danƙare a jikin gilasan mota a cikin makwaɓta na Birnin Mexico kamar su Xochimilco.

rows.output: Masana ilimin kasa sun lura da karuwar ayyukan a wani dutsen da ke da nisan mil 72 (kilomita 72) kudu maso gabashin babban birnin kasar tun bayan girgizar kasa mai karfin awo 7.1 da ta afku a tsakiyar kasar Mexico a watan Satumban 2017.
rows.reference: Masana kimiyyar yanayi sun lura da wani karin aiki a dutsin da ke zaune a mil 45 (kilomita 72) kudu-maso-gabas na babban birnin tun daga wata girgizar kasa da aka yi mai girman 7.1 da ta raguza tsakiyar Mexico a Satumba 2017.

rows.output: An yi aikin vulkan da ake kira "Don Goyo" tun daga shekarar 1994.
rows.reference: Dutsi mai amon wutar da ake kira "Don Goyo" ya daɗe yana tashi tun 1994.

rows.output: Rundunar ‘yan sanda ta yi artabu da masu fafutukar kafa kasar Catalan kafin ranar kafa kasar.
rows.reference: ’Yan sanda sun yi arangama da masu neman ɓallewa na Catalan kafin zagayowar bikin neman ‘yanci

rows.output: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona ranar Asabar bayan da masu fafutukar neman 'yancin kai suka yi artabu da 'yan sandan yaki, yayin da dubban mutane suka halarci zanga-zangar da suka yi a gaba da gaba domin tunawa da shekara ta farko da Catalonia ta gudanar da zaben raba gardama kan ficewa.
rows.reference: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan masu zanga-zangar nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi fito-na-fito tare da ‘yan sandan kwantar da tarzoma, kuma kamar yadda dubun-dubata suka shiga zanga-zanga ta adawa da juna don bikin zagayowar ranar kaɗa kuri’a da ta raba Catalonia a kan ɓallewa.

rows.output: Wani rukuni na masu nuna adawa da juna da suka rufe fuska sun yi kokarin hana 'yan sandan da ke yaki da rikici, suka jefa su da kwai, suka yi amfani da fenti, suka haifar da duhun hayaki a tituna da ake yawan cunkoson jama'a.
rows.reference: Wani gungu masu goyon bayan ɓallewar da suka rufe idanuwansu da ‘yan sanda suka riƙe sun jefe su da koyaye da kuma watsa musu fentin foda, inda suka ƙirƙiri wasu gajimare mai duhu a cikin titunan da yawanci sukan cika maƙil da ‘yan yawon shaƙatawa.

rows.output: An kuma yi artabu daga baya a ranar da ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da sandunansu wajen shawo kan lamarin.
rows.reference: Faɗace-faɗace sun ɓarke a ranar daga baya inda ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da kulaƙensu don hana faɗan.

rows.output: A cikin sa'o'i da dama, kungiyoyin masu fafutukar neman 'yancin kai sun yi ihu da "Babu mantawa, babu gafara", sun fuskanci masu zanga-zangar masu ra'ayin hadin kai suna ihu da "Rayuwa a Spain".
rows.reference: Har fiye da tsawon sa’o’i masu yawa gungu-gungun masu goyon bayan ɓallewar suna amshi “Babu mantuwa, babu yafiya” sun yi rikici da masu zanga-zanga ‘yan son haɗewa suna ihu, Allah ya ja kwanan Spain.”

rows.output: Maza 14 sun samu magani saboda kananan raunuka da suka samu a yayin zanga-zangar, a cewar kafafen yada labarai na cikin gida.
rows.reference: An yi magani a mutane goma sha huɗu don ƙananan raunuka da suka ji a zanga-zangogi, kamar yadda kafofin watsa labarai na gida suka ba da rahoto.

rows.output: Tashe-tashen hankula sun ci gaba da kasancewa a yankin da ke son yin garambawul shekara guda bayan kuri'ar raba gardama da aka gudanar a ranar 1 ga watan Oktoba, wanda majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi musu lakabi da haramtacce, amma 'yan kasar Catalonia na neman 'yancin kai sun yi bikin.
rows.reference: Har yanzu da tashin hankali sosai a lardin da ya sa ‘yanci a zuciyarsa shekara ɗaya bayan zaɓen raba gardama na 1 ga Oktoba wanda Madrid ke ɗauka ba ya bisa doka amma ‘yan Catalan masu neman ɓallewa ke ta yin murna da shi.

rows.output: Masu jefa ƙuri'a sun zabi da yawa su zama masu zaman kansu, duk da cewa an samu ƙarancin fitowar masu jefa ƙuri'a, saboda waɗanda suka yi adawa da rabuwa sun fi yin watsi da zaben.
rows.reference: Masu jefa kuri’ar sun yi zaɓe sosai inda suka zaɓi ‘yanci kodayake ba a fito sosai ba inda waɗanda ba sa son ɓallewa suka ƙauracewa zaɓen.

rows.output: A cewar hukumomin Catalan, sama da mutane 1000 ne suka ji rauni a shekarar da ta gabata bayan da ‘yan sanda suka yi yunkurin dakile zaben a rumfunan zabe a fadin yankin a lokacin tashin hankali.
rows.reference: A cewar hukumomin Catalan an aƙalla raunata mutane 1000 ne shekarar da ta wuce bayan ‘yan sanda sun yi ƙoƙarin su tsaida kaɗa kuri’ar da ake yi a wuraren jefa kuri’ar a dukkan faɗin lardin a cikin gumurzun tashin hankali.

rows.output: Ƙungiyoyin da ke goyon bayan 'yancin kai sun yi sansani a daren Juma'a don hana zanga-zangar goyon bayan 'yan sandan kasa.
rows.reference: Gungu-gungu na masu nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi dandazo waje da dare suna goyon baya na ‘yan sandan ƙasa.

rows.output: An gudanar da zanga-zangar amma an tilasta musu su dauki wata hanya ta daban.
rows.reference: Zanga-zangar ta ci gaba amma an tilasta mata ɗaukan wata hanya daban.

rows.output: Narcis Termes, 68, wani lantarki mai aikin kwanan nan da matarsa ​​sun halarci zanga-zangar neman 'yancin kai, ya ce ba shi da fata game da yiwuwar Catalonia ta samu 'yancin kai.
rows.reference: Narcis Termes, mai shekaru 68, wani latirisha da ke halartar zanga-zangar ‘yan neman ɓallewar tare da matarsa ya ce ba ya kuma fatan ganin yiwuwar Catalonia ta sami ‘yanci.

rows.output: Shekarar da ta gabata muka yi rayuwa ta daya daga cikin mafi kyawun lokutan mu.
rows.reference: “Shekarar da ta wuce mun rayu a cikin ɗaya daga cikin lokacinmu mafi kyau.

rows.output: Na kalli iyayena suna kuka da farin ciki saboda suna iya kada kuri'a amma yanzu muna makale," ya ce.
rows.reference: Na kalli iyayena suna kukan murna saboda damar jefa kuri’a amma yanzu mun tsaya ciki,” inji shi.

rows.output: Duk da nasarar da aka samu a zaben yankin a watan Disamba da ya gabata, jam'iyyun 'yancin kai na Catalan sun yi kokarin ci gaba da samun karfin gwiwa a wannan shekarar, yayin da shugabanninsu da aka fi sani da su suna cikin gudun hijira da kansu ko kuma a tsare a jiran shari'a bisa rawar da suka taka wajen shirya zaben raba gardama da sanarwar 'yancin kai da suka biyo baya.
rows.reference: Duk da gudanar da wata muhimmiyar nasara ko da tsukekkiya ce a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan yankin a Disamba da ta wuce, jam’iyyun da ke goyon bayan ‘yanci na Catalan sun yi gwagwarmaya don su ci gaba da hazaƙar wannan shekarar tare da yawancin sanannun fitattun shugabanninsu ko dai sun tafi neman mafakar da suka sa kansu ko an kame su suna jiran shari’a don rawarsu da suka taka a cikin shirya zaɓen raba gardamar da furuci na ‘yanci da suka yi daga baya.

rows.output: Joan Puig, wani mai shekaru 42 mai aikin gyaran motoci, wanda ke rubuta zanga-zangar goyon bayan ‘yan sanda a wayarsa, ya ce rikicin ya tsananta ne ta hannun ‘yan siyasa a bangarorin biyu.
rows.reference: Joan Puig, wani makanike mai shekaru 42 da ke daukan zanga-zanga a cikin goyon baya na ‘yan sanda a kan tarho dinsa, ya ce rikicin ya sami ruruwa ne daga ‘yan siyasa da ke dukkan bangarorin.

rows.output: "Yana ƙara ƙarfi da ƙarfi," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Yana ƙara ƙazanta sosai,” inji shi.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, daya daga cikin tsofaffin shugabannin Catalonia tara da ke tsare a gidan yari tun daga karshen shekarar da ta gabata, ya bayyana cewa zai tsaya takarar zaben majalisar Turai a shekara mai zuwa.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, ɗaya daga shugabanni tara na Catalan da ke tsare kafin a fara shari’a tun ƙarshen shekarar da ta wuce, ya sanar cewa zai tsaya zaɓuɓɓukan Majalisar Dokoki ta Turai a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.output: "Tsaya takarar zaben Turai hanya ce mafi kyau ta nuna adawa da koma bayan dabi'un dimokuradiyya da zalunci da gwamnatin Spain ta nuna," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Tsayawa a matsayin wani ɗan takara don zaɓuɓɓukan Turai shi ne hanya mafi kyau ta kin koma baya a kimomin dimokuraɗiyya da zalunci da muka gani daga gwamnatin Spain,” inji shi.

rows.output: Londonderry: An kama mutane bayan wata mota ta shiga wani gida
rows.reference: Londonderry: An kama masu maza bayan an doka mota a gida

rows.output: Mutane uku masu shekaru 33, 34, da 39 an kama su bayan an kai mota cikin gida a birnin Londonderry.
rows.reference: An kama wasu maza, masu shekaru 33, 34 da 29, bayan an ta maimaita doka wata ƙaramar mota zuwa cikin wani gida a da ke Londonderry.

rows.output: Lamarin ya faru ne a Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da kusan karfe 19:30 na yamma.
rows.reference: Abin ya faru ne a cikin Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da kusan ƙarfe 19:30 BST.

rows.output: Det Insp Bob Blemmings ya ce an lalata kofofin kuma ginin da kansa.
rows.reference: Mataimakin Sufeto Bob Blemmings ya ce an lalata ƙofofi da ma gidan kansa.

rows.output: Wani jirgin kasa na iya kuma harba motar a wani lokaci.
rows.reference: An kuma harba ƙila kwari da baka a kan ƙaramar motar a wani lokaci.

rows.output: Menga ya zura kwallo a raga ya bai wa Livingston nasara a kan Rangers da ci 1-0.
rows.reference: Cin da Menga ya yi ba wa Livingston nasara 1 da 0 a kan Rangers

rows.output: Dolly Menga ta zura kwallo ta farko a raga a kungiyar ta Livingston ta samu nasara
rows.reference: Cin ƙwallon Dolly Menga ya ba wa Livingston samun nasara

rows.output: An yi wa Livingston tayin da ba a zata ba, ya firgita Rangers, ya kuma sa Steven Gerrard ya yi rashin nasara na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 da ya yi a matsayin manajan kulob din Ibrox.
rows.reference: Livingston da aka ƙara wa girma ta ba da mamaki ga Rangers inda ta ajiye Steven Gerrard kawai zuwa ga cinsa da aka yi karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 a matsayinsa na manaja na kulob ɗin Ibrox.

rows.output: Kwallon da Dolly Menga ta yi ya nuna bambamcin da ya ba da damar Gary Holt's side ta yi daidai da Hibernian a matsayi na biyu.
rows.reference: Harin da Dolly Menga ya yi ya kasance abin da kawo bambanci saboda ɓangaren Gary Holt ya motsa lebur tare da Hibernian a cikin mataki na biyu.

rows.output: Kungiyar Gerrard har yanzu ba ta samu nasara a waje a gasar Premier a wannan kakar ba, kuma za ta kara da kungiyar Hearts, wadanda ke kan gaba da maki takwas, a ranar Lahadi mai zuwa.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren Gerrard yana nan ba tare da wata nasara da zai ta fi da ita ba a cikin wasan Premiership ɗin wannan lokacin kuma zai fuskanci Leaders Hearts, waɗanda suke bi da digo takwas, Lahadi mai zuwa.

rows.output: Kafin haka, Rangers na karbar bakuncin Rapid Vienna a gasar cin kofin Turai a ranar Alhamis.
rows.reference: Kafin nan, Rangers sun karɓi Rapid Vienna a cikin wasan Europa League a ranar Alhamis.

rows.output: Livingston, a halin yanzu, sun tsawaita wasannin da ba su yi rashin nasara ba a gasar zuwa wasanni shida, yayin da koci Holt ke jiran ya yi rashin nasara tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miller wata guda da ta wuce.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake ciki hakan, Livinsgton, sun kara matsayinsu na ba wanda ya doke su a cikin shiyyar zuwa wasanni shida, tare da shugaban horar da wasa Holt har yanzu don ɗanɗana dokewa tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miler wata da ya wuce.

rows.output: Livingston sun rasa damar cin kwallo a kan masu ziyara masu ban sha'awa
rows.reference: Livingston sun rasa damammaki a kan maziyartansu da ba su dama

rows.output: Kungiyar Holt ta kamata ta yi gaba da yawa kafin ta zura kwallo, saboda tsarin kai hari da suke yi ya haifar da matsala ga Rangers.
rows.reference: Ya kamata a ce ƙungiyar Holt suna gaba ne kafin su ci, tare da fuskantar tasu wanda ke haifar wa Rangers matsaloli iri-iri.

rows.output: Scott Robinson ya yi nasara a kan kai, sannan ya ja kwallon a fuskarsa, sannan Alan Lithgow ya yi nasara ne kawai bayan ya yi kokarin haduwa da kai.
rows.reference: Scott Robinson ya shige ciki amma ya ja ƙoƙarinsa ta gaban fuska ta cin nasara, shi ke nan Alan Lithgow kawai zai iya fuskantar da ƙoƙarinsa bayan yin ƙasa don haɗuwa da bugu da ka na cin Craig Halkett.

rows.output: Masu masaukin baki sun gamsu su bar Rangers su buga a gabansu, suna sanin cewa za su iya damun baƙi a lokacin da za a yi wasa.
rows.reference: Masu saukan bakin sun yarda su bar Rangers su buga wasa a gabansu, suna sane da cewa za su iya wahalar da masu ziyarar a jerin ɗaiɗaiku.

rows.output: Kuma haka aka zo daidai da yadda aka samu muhimmin kwallo.
rows.reference: Kuma wancan shi ne yadda ci mai muhimmancin ya gudana.

rows.output: An ba Rangers bugun daga kai sai mai tsaron gida, kuma Livingston ya yi amfani da shi, Declan Gallagher da Robinson sun hada kai don sa Menga, wanda ya dauki kwallo ya ci daga tsakiyar akwatin.
rows.reference: Rangers sun amince da bugun da ba tarewa kuma Livingston suka yi aiki da wata dama, Declan Gallagher da Robinson suka haɗe suka tsara Menga, wanda ya taɓa da kuma ci daga tsakiya ta akwatin.

rows.output: A wannan mataki, Rangers sun mamaye mallaka amma sun sami tsaron gida mai karfi da kuma mai tsaron gida Liam Kelly ba a damu da shi sosai.
rows.reference: A wannan mataki, Rangers ta mamaye riƙe ƙwallo amma ta sami tsaron gidan ba zai ba da damar wucewa ba kuma mai kama ƙwallo Liam Kelly kuma gaba ɗaya bai damu ba.

rows.output: Wannan salon ya ci gaba zuwa rabin na biyu, kodayake Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wa Kelly ya yi tsalle.
rows.reference: Wannan yanayi ya ci gaba har rabi na biyu, kodayake Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wani ceto daga Kelly.

rows.output: An hana Scott Pittman kwallon da Rangers mai tsaron gida Allan McGregor ya yi, kuma Lithgow ya yi kuskure daga wani shiri na kungiyar Livingston.
rows.reference: Scott Pittman bai samu dama ba daga ƙafa ta mai kama ƙwallo na Rangers Allan McGregor kuma Lithgow ya buɗa sosai daga wani wasan da Livingston ya tsara.

rows.output: An ci gaba da sanya giciye a cikin akwatin Livingston, kuma an ci gaba da share su, yayin da aka yi ikirarin biyu na bugun fanareti - bayan kalubalen da Halkett ya yi wa dan wasan Glenn Middleton, da kuma daya don hannu - an yi watsi da su.
rows.reference: Sai kuma bugu ta ko’ina da suka riƙa zuwa cikin akwatin Livingston inda kuma a ci gaba da maganinsu, a yayin da aka samu bugu daga kai sai gola - bayan ƙalubalantar Halkett a kan maye gurbin Glenn Middleton, kuma ɗaya don taɓawa da hannu - inda aka ture gefe.

rows.output: 'Phenomenal' daga Livingston - nazari
rows.reference: ‘Abin mamaki’ daga Livingston - nazari

rows.output: BBC Scotland's Alasdair Lamont a filin wasan kwaikwayo na Tony Macaroni
rows.reference: Alasdair Lamont Scotland a Yanki na Tony Macaroni

rows.output: Wani aiki mai ban mamaki da sakamako ga Livingston.
rows.reference: Wani wasa mai ban mamaki da sakamako don Livingston.

rows.output: Ga kowane mutum, sun kasance masu kyau sosai, suna ci gaba da wuce gona da iri a wannan hanyar hawa.
rows.reference: Ga wani mutum, sun burge sosai, suna ci gaba da wuce abin da ake tsammani a kan wannan abin da ya yi saman.

rows.output: Salon wasansu da kuma 'yan wasan su ba su canza sosai tun lokacin da suka dawo gasar firimiya ba, amma dole ne a bada kudin ga Holt kan yadda ya karfafa kungiyar tun lokacin da ya iso.
rows.reference: Irin salonsu na wasa da ma’aikata ya dan canza tun da dawowarsu zuwa saman matsayi, amma babban yabo ya kamata ya je ne ga Holt da irin hanyar da ya haɗa ƙungiyar tun zuwansa.

rows.output: Ya yi wa mutane da yawa jarumai.
rows.reference: Yana da gwarzaye da yawa.

rows.output: Kyaftin Halkett ya kasance mai girma, yana tara wata kare ta tsaro mai kyau, yayin da Menga ya ci gaba da Connor Goldson da Joe Worrall a duk lokacin.
rows.reference: Kyaftin Halkett ya shirya, inda ya yi ta tsara wani tsaro mai kyau, a lokacin da Menga ya sa Connor Goldson da Joe Worrall suka kasance a kan ƙafafunsu gaba ɗaya.

rows.output: An yi kasa da tunani, duk da haka.
rows.reference: Rangers sun kusan rasa ƙarfin gwiwa, kusan.

rows.output: Kamar yadda suka yi kyau a wasu lokuta a karkashin jagorancin Gerrard, sun yi kasa da wadannan ka'idoji sosai.
rows.reference: Duk da irin yadda suke da kyau a lokutan a ƙarƙashin Gerrard, sun gaza samun irin wadannan daidaituwar.

rows.output: Kwallonsu ta karshe ba ta isa ba - kawai suka yi kokarin shiga tsakani - kuma hakan wani gargaɗi ne ga Rangers, wadanda suke tsakiyar teburin.
rows.reference: Ƙwallonsu ta ƙarshe ba ta isa ba - kawai sau ɗaya ne suka yanke gefen gidan a buɗe - kuma wani abu ne na wartsakarwar kira ga Rangers, waɗanda suka sami kansu a cikin tsakiyar teburi.

rows.output: An yi wa Erdogan karɓuwa daban-daban a Cologne
rows.reference: Erdogan ya sami wata irin karɓa a Cologne

rows.output: A ranar Asabar (29 ga Satumba) an yi murmushi da sararin sama mai shuɗi yayin da shugabannin Turkiyya da Jamus suka gana a Berlin don karin kumallo.
rows.reference: An ga murmurshi iri-iri da shuɗin sararin samaniya a ranar Asabar (29 ga Satumba) inda shugabannin Turkiyya da Jamus suka haɗu don cin kumallon safe a cikin Berlin.

rows.output: Yau rana ta ƙarshe ta ziyarar shugaban ƙasar Turkiyya Erdogan mai jawo cece-kuce a Jamus, wadda aka yi niyya don gyara dangantaka tsakanin abokan tarayya na NATO.
rows.reference: A cikin ranarta ta ƙarshen ziyarar Shugaba Erdogan mai rikitarwa zuwa Jamus - wanda aka tsara don gyara hulɗoɗi tsakanin ƙawayen NATO din.

rows.output: Sun yi takun saka ne kan batutuwa da suka hada da ‘yancin dan adam, ‘yancin yada labarai, da kuma shiga kasar Turkiyya cikin EU.
rows.reference: Sun sami rashin jituwa a kan wasu batutuwa da suka haɗa da ‘yancin ɗan Adam, ‘yancin ‘yan jarida da shigar Turkiyyar zuwa Tarayyar Turai.

rows.output: Erdogan ya tafi Cologne ya bude wani babban masallaci.
rows.reference: Erdogan daga nan ya wuce Cologne don buɗe wani ƙaton sabon masallaci.

rows.output: Birnin na da yawan jama'ar Turkiyya mafi girma a wajen Turkiyya.
rows.reference: Birnin gida ne ga mutanen Turkiyya da suka fi yawa a wajen Turkiyyar.

rows.output: Jami'an 'yan sanda sun bayyana cewa sun hana taron mutane 25,000 da suka tara a gaban masallacin saboda matsalolin tsaro, amma akwai masoya da dama da suka tara a kusa da shi don ganin shugabansu.

rows.output: Kimanin mutane 16,700 an kwashe su zuwa cibiyoyi 24 a Palu.
rows.reference: An kwashe kusan mutane 16,700 zuwa cibiyoyi 24 da ke cikin Palu.

rows.output: Hotunan jiragen sama da hukumar kula da bala’o’i ta fitar sun nuna cewa an lalata gine-gine da shaguna da dama, an murkushe gada, kuma an rufe masallaci da ruwa.
rows.reference: Hotunan da aka ɗauka daga sama da hukumar haɗarin ta sake sun nuna gine-gine da shaguna a lalace, gadojin sun lankwashe da rushewa da wani masallaci ruwa ya kewaye shi.

rows.output: An ci gaba da girgizar kasa a garin bakin teku a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An ci gaba da samun girgize-girgize na baya da suka addabi birnin da ke kusa da tekun a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi ta girgizar kasa a yankin da ke da mutane miliyan 2.4.
rows.reference: An ji girgize-girgizen ƙasa a jere a wani yanki mai mutane miliyan 2 da dubu ɗari 4.

rows.output: Hukumar tantancewa da amfani da fasaha ta Indonesia (BPPT) ta ce a cikin wata sanarwa cewa, makamashin da aka saki daga girgizar kasa mai karfi a ranar Juma'a ya kai kusan sau 200 fiye da karfin bam din atomic da aka jefa a Hiroshima a yakin duniya na biyu.
rows.reference: Hukumar Auna da Aiwatar da Fasaha ta Indonesiya (BPPT) a cikin wata sanarwa ta ce ƙarfi da babbar girgizar ƙasa ta sake a ranar Jumu’ar ya kai kusan sau 200 na ƙarfin bam na sinadarin atom da aka jefa a kan Hiroshima a cikin Yakin Duniya na Biyu.

rows.output: Yankin birnin, wanda ke kasan wani dogon bakin ruwa mai tsawo, na iya kara girman tsunami, a cewar rahoton.
rows.reference: Yanayi na birnin, wanda ke zaune a ƙarshe na wani ɗan ƙaramin ziri mai tsawo, ƙila shi ya faɗaɗa girma na tsunami ɗin, inji ta.

rows.output: Nugroho ya bayyana barnar a matsayin "mai yawa" ya kuma ce dubban gidaje, asibitoci, manyan shaguna, da otal-otal sun ruguje.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin “mai yawa” kuma ya ce dubun-dubata na gidaje, asibitoci, shagunan cinikayya da otel-otel duk sun ruguje.

rows.output: An gano gawarwakin wasu wadanda suka mutu a karkashin tarkacen gine-ginen da suka ruguje, ya ce, ya kuma bayyana cewa mutane 540 sun jikkata kuma 29 sun bace.
rows.reference: An sami gawarwakin waɗanda abin ya shafa a maƙale a ƙarƙashin gine-gine da suka rushe, inji shi, ya kuma ƙara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma an rasa 29.

rows.output: Nugroho ya ce, wadanda suka mutu da kuma barnar da aka yi na iya fiye da haka a bakin tekun, kilomita 300 (mil 190) arewa da Palu, wani yanki mai suna Donggala, wanda ke kusa da cibiyar girgizar kasa.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya ce yawan masu mutuwar da lalacewar zai ƙaru sosai a layin bakin teku kilomita 300 (mil 190) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala,

rows.output: Harshe "sun kasance gaba daya cikin rugujewa ba tare da wani bayani ba" daga Donggala, Nugroho ya ce.
rows.reference: Sadarwa “gaba ɗaya sun tsaya cik kuma babu labari” daga Donggala, jinji Nugroho.

rows.output: Akwai sama da mutane 300,000 da ke zaune a wurin, a cewar wata sanarwa da kungiyar Red Cross ta fitar, inda ta bayyana cewa ma'aikatansu da masu aikin sa kai suna kan hanyar zuwa yankunan da abin ya shafa.
rows.reference: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zauna a can,” inji ƙungiyar agaji ta Red Cross a cikin wata sanarwa, tana mai ƙarin cewa ma’aikatanta da masu sa-kai sun nufi yankunan da abin ya shafa.

rows.output: "Wannan ya riga ya zama bala'i, amma zai iya kara tabarbarewa," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Wannan tuni wani bala’i ne, amma zai iya ƙara muni,” inji ta.

rows.output: Hukumar ta fuskanci suka a ranar Asabar saboda rashin sanar da cewa wani tsunami ya afku a Palu, duk da cewa jami'ai sun bayyana cewa igiyoyin sun zo cikin lokacin da aka fitar da gargadin.
rows.reference: An soki hukumar a ranar Asabar sosai don rashin sanarwa cewa wata tsunami za ta afka wa Palu, kodayake jami’ai sun ce igiyoyin ruwa sun zo a tsakanin lokacin da aka fitar da gargaɗin.

rows.output: A cikin bidiyon da ba na kwararru ba da aka raba a shafukan sada zumunta, wani mutum a saman bene na wani gini yana yi wa mutane a titin da ke kasa kururuwa cikin gaggawa game da wani igiyar ruwa da ke tafe.
rows.reference: Wani bidiyon da ba ƙwararre ba da aka raba ta kafar sada zumunta za a iya jin wani mutum a kan saman daɓe na wani gini yana ihun girgiza gargaɗi na kusantowar tsunami ga mutane da ke titin ƙasan.

rows.output: A cikin mintuna, ruwa ya fado kan gabar teku, yana ɗauke da gine-gine da motoci.
rows.reference: A cikin mintina wani bango na ruwa ya faɗo a kan tekun, yana ɗaukewa gine-gine da ƙananan motoci.

rows.output: Reuters ba a iya tabbatar da fuskokin nan da nan ba.
rows.reference: Kamfanin dillacin labarai na Reuters ba iya tantance bidiyon ba nan da nan.

rows.output: Harin da ya haifar da wani babban katsewar wutar lantarki da ya shafi sadarwa a kusa da Palu, wanda ya sa ya yi wahala ga hukumomi su tsara kokarin ceto.
rows.reference: Girgizar ƙasar da tsunamin sun haifar da katsewar lantarki da yanke sadarwa a kewayen Palu inda ya haifar da wahala ga hukumomi wajen haɗin gamayyar ƙoƙare-ƙoƙare na ceto.

rows.output: An fara aikawa da jiragen sama masu ɗaukar kaya da taimako daga Jakarta da sauran biranen, a cewar hukumomi, amma wadanda aka kwashe har yanzu suna buƙatar abinci da sauran bukatun asali sosai.
rows.reference: Sojoji sun fara aika manyan jiragen ɗaukan kaya da tallafi daga Jakarta da sauran birane, inji hukumomi, amma waɗanda aka kwashen har yanzu suna sosai buƙatar abinci da sauran muhimman kayayyaki.

rows.output: Birnin ya bude filin jirgin sa ne kawai don ayyukan agaji kuma zai ci gaba da kasancewa a rufe har zuwa Oktoba.
rows.reference: An sake buɗe filin jirgin sama na birnin kaɗai don ƙoƙare-ƙoƙaren kayan agaji kuma zai kasance a rufe sai har Octoba.

rows.output: Shugaban Joko Widodo ya shirya ziyartar cibiyoyin tattara mutane a Palu ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: An tsara Shugaba Joko Widodo zai ziyarci cibiyoyin kwashewa mutane a cikin Palu a ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: Indoneshiya ta fuskanci ambaliyar ruwa mai ban mamaki da ta haddasa mutuwar sama da 800.

rows.output: Yana da muni sosai.

rows.output: Yayin da ma'aikatan Vision na Duniya daga Donggala suka isa birnin Palu cikin aminci, inda ma'aikata ke kwana a cikin tarkacen da aka kafa a cikin fadar gidan su, sun wuce wuraren da lalacewa a kan hanyarsu, in ji Mista Doseba.
rows.reference: Kodayake ma’aikatan World Vision sun koma birnin Palu lafiya ƙalau daga Donggala, inda ma’aikatan ke zaune a matsugunan tanfol da aka kafa a farfajiyar ofishin nasu, sun nuna wani hali na rugujewa a kan hanyar, inji Mista Doseba.

rows.output: "Suna cewa sun ga gidaje da yawa da aka lalata," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Sun faɗa mun sun ga gidaje da yawa da suka rushe,” inji shi.

rows.output: Yana da muni sosai.
rows.reference: Abin ya ɓaci sosai.

rows.output: Ko da yake kungiyoyin agaji sun fara aikin da ya dace na fara injin aikin agaji, wasu sun yi korafi cewa ma'aikatan agajin kasashen waje masu zurfin kwarewa ana hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.
rows.reference: Duk da gungu-gungun ‘yan agaji da suka fara wata babbar hoɓɓasa ta fara aikin tallafi na bala’i, wasu sun yi ƙorafi cewa ma’aikatan agaji na waje da ke ƙwarewa sosai ana hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.

rows.output: Bisa ga dokokin Indonesiya, kudade, kayayyaki da ma'aikata daga kasashen waje za su iya fara gudana ne kawai idan wurin bala'i an bayyana shi a matsayin yankin bala'i na kasa.
rows.reference: A cewar ƙa’idojin Indonesiya, kashe kuɗaɗe, samarwa da ba da ma’aikata daga ƙasashen waje kawai zai fara ne idan an furta wuri na fitina a matsayin zango na bala’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: Har yanzu hakan bai faru ba.
rows.reference: Hakan har yanzu bai faru ba.

rows.output: "Har yanzu bala'i ne na matakin lardi," in ji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun kungiyar agaji ta Red Cross ta Indonesia.
rows.reference: “Har yanzu wani lebur ne yankin bala’i,” inji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun Red Cross ta Indonesiya.

rows.output: "Da zarar gwamnati ta ce, "Lafiya, wannan wani bala'i ne na kasa," za mu iya bude don taimakon kasa da kasa amma har yanzu ba a samu matsayi ba."
rows.reference: Da zarar gwamnatin ta ce, “Ya yi, wannan zai zama wani bala’i na ƙasa,” za mu buɗe don taimakon ƙasa-da-ƙasa amma babu matsayin har yanzu.”

rows.output: Yayin da dare na biyu ya sauka a Palu bayan girgizar kasa da tsunami a ranar Juma'a, abokai da 'yan uwa na wadanda har yanzu ba a gano su ba suna fatan cewa 'yan uwansu za su zama abubuwan al'ajabi da za su sa labaran tashin hankali na bala'o'i su yi kyau.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda dare na biyu ya faɗa kan Palu bayan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami ta ranar Jumu’a, abokai da iyali na waɗanda suka ɓata suna ta fatan cewa ‘yan uwan nasu za su zama mu’ujizozi da za su rayar da layukan labari marar daɗi na bala’o’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, an cire wani yaro karami daga cikin bututun ruwa.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, an ciro wani ƙaramin yaro daga wata matattar datti.

rows.output: A ranar Lahadi ne, an ceto wata mata da aka makale a karkashin tarkacen gini tsawon kwanaki biyu tare da jikar mahaifiyarta a gefenta.
rows.reference: A ranar Lahadi, masu ceto sun ‘yantar da wata mata wanda ta kasance tana ƙarƙashin burbushi na kwanaki biyu tare da gawar mahaifiyarta kusa da ita.

rows.output: Kocin tawagar paragliding ta kasa ta Indonesia, Gendon Subandono, ya horar da biyu daga cikin masu yin paragliding da suka bace domin gasar Asiya, wadda ta kare a baya a watan da ya gabata a Indonesia.
rows.reference: Gendon Subandono, mai horar da ‘yan wasa na Ɗƙungiyar ‘yan sauka daga sama na Indonesiya, ya horar da ‘yan wasan biyu da suka bace na Wasannin Asiya, wanda aka gama a farkon wannan watan a cikin Indonesiya.

rows.output: Wasu daga cikin wadanda suka makale a otal din Roa Roa, Mista Mandagi ya hada da dalibansa.
rows.reference: Saura daga cikin waɗanda aka rutsa da su a otel ɗin Roa Roa, har da Mista Mandagi, ɗalibansa ne.

rows.output: "A matsayin babban mutum a fagen tashi da parachute, ina da nauyin zuciya na," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “A matsayi wani babba a cikin wasan saukowa daga saman, ni ma ina nawa taƙaicin da nake ji,” inji shi.

rows.output: Mista Gendon ya ba da labarin yadda, a cikin sa'o'in da suka biyo bayan labarin rugujewar otal din Roa Roa, ya yi yunkurin aika saƙonni na WhatsApp ga 'yan wasan Palu, wadanda ke halartar bikin bakin teku.
rows.reference: Mista Gendon ya ba da bayanin yadda aka yi, a cikin sa’o’i bayan labarin rushewar otel ɗin Roa Roa da aka watsa a tsakanin al’ummar wasan saukowa daga saman, ya aika sakonnin WhatsApp a dugunzume zuwa masu gasa ta Palu, waɗanda ke shiga cikin bikin na bakin tekun.

rows.output: Saƙonninsa, duk da haka, sun haifar da alamar dubawa mai launin toka ɗaya kawai, maimakon duban shuɗi biyu.
rows.reference: Sakonninsa, kodayake, kawai sun haifar da alamar launin toka guda mai zane, a maimakon wani guda biyu na zane-zane shudi.

rows.output: Ina ganin hakan na nufin sakonnin ba a isar da su ba," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Ina jin yana nufi ba a aika sakonni ne ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: An sace dala 26,750 a lokacin cika ATM a Newport on the Levee
rows.reference: Ɓarayi sun ɗauki dala 26,750 a lokacin sake cika ATM a Newport a kan Daɓe

rows.output: An yi sata ne a ranar Juma'a da safe, an sace dala 26,750 daga ma'aikacin Brink da ke cike ATM a Newport on the Levee, a cewar wata sanarwa da 'yan sandan Newport suka fitar.
rows.reference: Ɓarayi a ranar Juma’a da safe sun sace dala 26,750 daga wurin wani ma’aikacin Brink da ke sake cika wani ATM a Newport a kan Daɓe, a cewar wani labari da aka sake daga Ma’aikatar ‘Yan Sanda ta Newport.

rows.output: Direban motar ya kasance yana fitar da wani ATM a cikin hadaddiyar cibiyar nishaɗi kuma yana shirin isar da ƙarin kuɗi, Det. Dennis McCarthy ya rubuta a cikin sanarwar.
rows.reference: Direban ƙaramar motar yana cirewa wani ATM a cikin wani gini na nishaɗi da shiryawa don kawo ƙarin kuɗi, Det. Dennis McCarthy ya rubuta a cikin sanarwar.

rows.output: Yayin da yake cikin wannan hali, wani mutum ya yi gudu daga bayan ma'aikacin Brink ya sace jaka da kudin da za a kai.
rows.reference: A lokacin da yake cikin aiki, wani mutum “ya zo a guje daga bayan ma’aikacin na Brink” kuma ya saci jakar kuɗi da za a kawo.

rows.output: Shaidu sun lura da masu zargi da dama suna guduwa daga wurin, a cewar sanarwar, amma ‘yan sandan ba su bayyana adadin wadanda ke da hannu a lamarin ba.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar Mexico mai jiran gado Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin ba zai taba amfani da karfin soji a kan fararen hula ba yayin da kasar ke gab da cika shekaru 50 da wani mummunan martani da dalibai suka yi.
rows.reference: Zaɓaɓɓen Shugaban Ƙasar Mexico Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin ba zai taɓa yin amfani da ƙarfin soja a kan fararen hula ba a yayin da ƙasar ke kusantar cika shekaru 50 na wani murƙushewar da aka yi wa ɗalibai da aka zubar da jini.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari a ranar Asabar a filin Tlatelolco da ba zai taba amfani da sojoji wajen murkushe mutanen Mexico ba.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari ranar Asabar a Tlatelolco Plaza “kar a taɓa ko kaɗan amfani da sojoji wajen murƙushe mutanen Mexico.”

rows.output: Sojoji sun harbe wani zanga-zangar lumana a filin wasa a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda suka kashe mutane kusan 300 a lokacin da motsin juyin juya hali na dalibai masu ra'ayin hagu ke fara samun karfi a duk fadin Latin Amurka.
rows.reference: Rundunonin sun yi harbi a kan wata zanga-zangar lumana a cibiyar a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda suka kashe da yawa har mutane 300 a wani lokaci yayin da ɗalibai ‘yan gwagwarmayar ra’ayin gurguzu suka fara samun matsuguni a Latin America.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin tallafawa matasa 'yan Mexico ta hanyar bayar da kudaden tallafi na wata-wata ga wadanda ke karatu da kuma bude karin jami'o'in gwamnati kyauta.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari na goyon bayan samari ‘yan Mexico ta ba da tallafe-tallafe na wata-wata ga waɗanda ke karatu kuma da buɗe ƙarin jami’o’i na gwamnati kyauta.

rows.output: Ya ce rashin aikin yi da rashin damar ilimi na jan hankalin matasa zuwa kungiyoyin masu aikata laifuka.

rows.output: Ya kamata Amurka ta ninka kudaden binciken A.I.

rows.output: Yayin da Sin ke kara shiga harkar basirar wucin gadi, ya kamata Amurka ta ninka kudaden da take kashewa wajen bincike a fannin, in ji masanin zuba jari kuma mai aiki da AI, wanda ya yi aiki a Google, Microsoft da Apple.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda China ta zama tana aiki sosai a cikin hikimar da ba ta asali ba, ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya yawan abin da take kashewa a cikin nazari da ke cikin filin, inji mai zuba jari mai gwada hikimar da ba ta asalin ba Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki da Google, Microsoft da Apple.

rows.output: Bayanin ya zo ne bayan sassa daban-daban na gwamnatin Amurka sun yi sanarwar AI, duk da cewa Amurka gabaɗaya ba ta da wata dabarar AI ta hukuma.
rows.reference: Sharhohin suna zuwa ne bayan ɓangarori da dama na gwamnatin Amurka sun yi furuci a kan AI na hikimar da ba ta asalin ba, duk da cewa Amurka ta rasa wata dabarar AI a  tsare.

rows.output: A halin yanzu, kasar Sin ta gabatar da shirinta a shekarar da ta gabata: tana da burin zama ta daya a fannin kirkire-kirkire na AI nan da shekarar 2030.
rows.reference: A halin da ake cikin, China ta gabatar da shirinta shekarar da ta wuce: tana ƙoƙarin ta zama ta farko a cikin ƙago AI a shekara ta 2030.

rows.output: "Ƙara kasafin kuɗin binciken AI sau biyu zai zama kyakkyawan farawa, idan aka yi la'akari da cewa duk sauran ƙasashe sun yi nisa sosai a bayan Amurka, kuma muna neman sabon ci gaba a cikin AI," in ji Lee.
rows.reference: “Ruɓanya kasafin kuɗi na AI zai zama wani mafari mai kyau, ganin cewa dukkan sauran ƙasashe sun yi gaba sosai a bayan Amurka kuma muna neman wani sabon abu a cikin AI,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Ƙara kuɗi na iya ƙara damar cewa babban nasarar AI na gaba za a yi a Amurka, Lee ya gaya wa CNBC a cikin hira a wannan makon.
rows.reference: Ruɓanya kashe kuɗi zai iya rubanya damammaki inda za a cimma babban AI na gaba a cikin Amurka, Lee ya ce wa CNBC a cikin wata intabiyu wannan makon.

rows.output: To, littafinta mai suna "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" an buga shi a wannan watan ta Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, shugaban kamfanin Sinovation Ventures ne, wanda ya zuba jari a daya daga cikin manyan kamfanonin AI a kasar Sin, Face++.
rows.reference: Lee, wanda Houghton Mifflin Harcourt ya buga littafinsa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order"  wannan watan, shi ne Babban Shugaba na Sinovation Ventures China, wanda ya zuba jari a cikin daya daga sanannun kamfanonin AI a cikin China, Face++.

rows.output: A cikin shekarun 1980 a Jami'ar Carnegie Mellon, ya yi aiki kan tsarin AI wanda ya doke mafi kyawun dan wasan Othello na Amurka, kuma daga baya ya kasance shugaban gudanarwa a Microsoft Research da kuma shugaban rassa na Google na kasar Sin.
rows.reference: A cikin shekaru na 1980 a Jami’ar Carnegie Mellon ya yi aiki a kan wani tsarin AI da ya doke ɗan wasan Amurka Othello da ya fi matsayi, daga baya kuma ya zama wani zababben shugaba a Microsoft Research da shugaban Google na reshen China.

rows.output: Lokacin da aka amince da gasa da gwamnatin Amurka ta yi a baya a fannin fasaha kamar kalubalen binciken fasahar tsaro na DARPA da kuma tambayar lokacin da na gaba zai kasance, domin taimakawa wajen gano masu tunani na gaba.
rows.reference: Lee ya faɗi gasa ta baya ta gwamnatin Amurka a kan fasaha kamar Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge inda ya tambaya yaushe ne za a yi na gaban, saboda ya taimaka gane masu hange nesa na gaba.

rows.output: Masana a Amurka sukan yi aiki tuƙuru don samun tallafin gwamnati, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Manazarta a cikin Amurka yawanci sukan yi aiki tuƙuru saboda cin taimakon kuɗaɗen gwamnati, inji Lee.

rows.output: "Ba kasar Sin ce ke daukar shugabannin ilimi ba; kamfanoni ne." Lee ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ba China ne ke ɗaukewa shugabannin ilmi ba; kamfanoni ne,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun dauki masana kimiyya daga jami'o'i don yin aiki kan AI a cikin 'yan shekarun nan.
rows.reference: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun ɗauki hayar manyan masu ilmi daga jami’o’i don aiki a kan AI a shekarun kwana nan.

rows.output: Lee ta ce canje-canjen manufofin shige da fice na iya taimakawa Amurka wajen karfafa kokarinta na AI.
rows.reference: Lee ya ce canje-canjen ƙudurin shiga ƙasa zai iya kuma taimakon Amurka ta daga ƙoƙare-ƙoƙarenta na AI.

rows.output: Ina ganin katin zinare ya kamata a ba wa PhD a fannin AI, ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ina jin ya kamata korayen katina su zama kai-tsaye ake samar da su ga masu digirin-digirgir a fannin hikimar AI da ba ta asali ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: Hukumar Jiha ta kasar Sin ta fitar da tsarin ci gaban fasahar kere-kere ta na gaba a watan Yuli 2017.
rows.reference: Majalisar Ƙasar China ta fitar da Shirin Ci Gaban Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Don Al’ummar Gaba nata a cikin Yulin 2017.

rows.output: Asusun Kimiyya na Duniya na Sin yana ba da kudi ga mutane a cibiyoyin ilimi iri ɗaya da Hukumar Kimiyya ta Kasa da sauran ƙungiyoyin gwamnati ke bayarwa ga masu bincike na Amurka, amma ingancin aikin ilimi ya yi ƙasa da na Sin, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Gidauniyar Kimiyya na Halitta ta Ƙasa ta China ta samar da kuɗaɗe ga mutane a makarantun ilmi irin zuwa ga hanyar da Gidauniyar Kimiyyar ta Ƙasa da sauran hukumomin gwamnati ke ba da kuɗi ga manazartan Amurka, amma yanayin darajar aikin ilmi ya yi ƙasa a cikin China, inji Lee.

rows.output: A farkon wannan shekarar, Ma'aikatar Tsaron Amurka ta kafa Cibiyar Haɗin Gwiwar Artificial Intelligence, wacce aka yi niyya don haɗa abokan hulɗa daga masana'antu da ilimi, kuma fadar White House ta sanar da kafa Kwamitin Zaɓe na Artificial Intelligence.
rows.reference: A farkon wannan shekarar Ma’aikatar Tsaro ta Amurka ta kafa wata Cibiyar Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Ba, wanda aka shirya don ta sa abokan hulɗa daga masana’anta da makaranta, kuma fadar White House ta sanar da ƙirƙirar wani Zaɓaɓɓen Kwamiti a kan Hikimar da ba ta asali ba.

rows.output: Kuma a wannan watan, DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a wani shiri mai suna AI Next.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan watan DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a cikin wani ƙoƙari da ake kira AI Next.

rows.output: Game da NSF, a halin yanzu tana saka hannun jari sama da dala miliyan 100 a duk shekara a binciken AI.
rows.reference: A game da NSF, a yanzu haka ta zuba jarin fiye da dala miliyan 100 a kowace shekara a cikin binciken AI.

rows.output: A halin yanzu, dokar Amurka da nufin kafa wata hukumar tsaro ta kasa kan hankali na wucin gadi ba ta samu ci gaba ba cikin watanni.
rows.reference: A halin da ake ciki yanzu, dokar Amurka da ke neman ƙirƙirar wata Hukumar Tsaron Ƙasa kan Hikimar Da Ba Asali tana nan ba ta ga wani aiki ba a cikin watanni.

rows.output: Macedoniyawa suna kada kuri'a a kan yin zabe kan ko za a canza sunan kasar
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia suna jefa kuri’ar raba gardama a kan ko a canza sunan ƙasar

rows.output: Mutanen Makidoniya sun kada kuri'a a ranar Lahadi kan ko za a canza sunan kasar zuwa "Jamhuriyar Arewacin Makidoniya," matakin da zai warware rikicin da ya dade da dadewa da kasar Girka, wadda ta hana shiga cikin Tarayyar Turai da NATO.
rows.reference: Mutanen Macedonia sun jefa kuri’a a cikin wata raba gardama a ranar Lahadi ko ta canza sunanta zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Arewacin Macedonia,” a wani yinƙuri da zai warware wata tsohuwar taƙaddama tare da Greece wadda ta toshe nemanta na zama mamba don Tarayyar Turai da NATO.

rows.output: Girka, wadda ke da wani lardi mai suna Macedonia, ta tabbatar da cewa sunan makwabtanta na arewa yana wakiltar ikirari kan yankinta kuma ta hana shigowar ta cikin NATO da EU.
rows.reference: Greece, wadda ke da wani yanki da ake kira Macedonia, ya nace da cewa sunan makwabciyarta ta arewa yana wakiltar wani nema ne a kan iyakarta kuma ta hau-kujerar-na-ki na shiganta cikin NATO da Tarayyar Turai.

rows.output: Gwamnatocin biyu sun cimma yarjejeniya a watan Yuni bisa sunan da aka ba da shawarar, amma masu adawa da ra'ayin suna jayayya cewa canjin zai gurgunta asalin kabilanci na mafi yawan al'ummar Slavic na Macedonia.
rows.reference: Gwamnatin biyu sun sami wata matsayi a Yuni a bisa wani sabon suna da suka ƙudurta, amma masu adawa na ‘yan kasanci sun yi mahawara canjin zai rage shaidar ƙabilanci na jama’a ‘yan Slav da suka yawa na Macedonia.

rows.output: Shugaban Gjorge Ivanov ya bayyana cewa ba zai kada kuri'a ba a zaben da za a yi, kuma yakin neman zaben ya haifar da shakku ko za a samu kuri'u da suka dace da kashi 50 cikin 100 da ake bukata domin zaben ya zama da inganci.
rows.reference: Shugaba Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zaɓe a cikin raba gardamar ba kuma wani kamfe na ƙauracewa ya sa shakku a kan ko yawan fitowar zai isa matsaikacin kashi 50 cikin ɗari da ake buƙata don raba gardamar ta inganta.

rows.output: Tambayar da aka yi a kai a kai ta karanta: "Kuna goyon bayan shiga NATO da EU tare da karɓar yarjejeniyar da Girka?"
rows.reference: Tambayar da ke kan kuri’ar raba gardamar tana cewa: “Kai na NATO da zama mamban Tarayyar Turai ne da yarda da yarjejeniyar tare da Greece.”

rows.output: Masu goyon bayan canza sunan, ciki har da Firayim Minista Zoran Zaev, suna jayayya cewa hakan farashi ne da ya dace domin neman shiga kungiyoyi kamar EU da NATO na Masedoniya, daya daga cikin kasashen da suka fito daga rugujewar Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Masu goyon bayan canza sunan, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun yi mahawara cewa wata sadaukarwa ce don bin shiga cikin hukumomin kamar su Tarayyar Turai da NATO don Macedonia, ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe da suka bayyana daga rushewa ta Yugoslavia.

rows.output: Na zo yau ne domin kada kuri'a ga makomar kasar, ga matasa a Masedoniya su samu damar rayuwa cikin walwala a karkashin inuwar Tarayyar Turai domin yana nufin rayuwa mai aminci ga kowa." in ji Olivera Georgijevska, 'yar shekara 79, a Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na zo nan yau don jefa kuri’a don makoma ta ƙasar, don mutane samari a cikin Macedonia saboda za su iya rayuwa da ‘yanci a ƙarƙashin lema ta Tarayyar Turai saboda yana nufin rayuwa mai tsaro a gare mu,” inji Olivera Georgijevska, mai shekaru 79, a cikin Skopje.

rows.output: Duk da cewa ba a wajabta ta doka ba, amma da yawa daga cikin mambobin majalisar dokoki sun bayyana cewa za su bi sakamakon kuri'ar, don haka ta zama mai tsauri.
rows.reference: Kodayake ba ya da ƙarfi na shari’a, isassun mambobi na majalisar dokoki sun ce za su bi sakamako na jefa kuri’ar don ta zama ta daidaita.

rows.output: Sake suna zai bukaci kashi biyu bisa uku na rinjaye a majalisar dokoki.
rows.reference: Canza sunan zai buƙaci wan yawa na kashi biyu bisa uku na majalisar dokokin.

rows.output: Hukumar zabe ta jihar ta ce ba a samu wani rahoto na rashin da'a ba da karfe 1 na rana.
rows.reference: Hukumar zaɓe ta ƙasar ta ce babu rahotanni na matsaloli har zuwa ƙarfe 1 na rana.

rows.output: Duk da haka, fitowar masu kada kuri'a ta kai kashi 16 cikin 100, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 34 cikin 100 a zaben majalisar dokokin 2016, lokacin da kashi 66 cikin 100 na masu kada kuri'a suka kada kuri'unsu.
rows.reference: Amma, fitowar ta tsaya kawai a kashi 15 cikin ɗari, idan an kwatanta da kashi 34 a cikin ɗari a zaɓen majalisar dokoki na 2016 a yayin da kashi 66 cikin ɗari na masu jefa kuri’a da ke rijista suka kaɗa kuri’arsu.

rows.output: "Na fito na zabe saboda 'ya'yana mata, wurinmu yana Turai ne," Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wanda ya yi zabe a babban birnin kasar, Skopje, ya ce.
rows.reference: “Na fito ne don jefa kuri’a saboda ‘ya’yana, matsayinmu yana cikin Turai ne,” inji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wani mai jefa kuri’a cikin babban birnin, Skopje.

rows.output: Ndị omeiwu Welsh na-echegbu onwe ha banyere "ịdị ka muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AM na enwe mgbakasị ahụ maka ‘ị dị ka ihe egwuregwu’

rows.output: Enwere nchegbu n'etiti ụfọdụ AMs maka aro ka a gbanwee aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Onye otu nzuko omeiwu Welsh).
rows.reference: Enwere nchekasị ahụ n’ime ụfọdụ AMs maka ntụle na ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

rows.output: Ọ na-eme n'ihi atụmatụ ịgbanwe aha ụlọ ọgbakọ ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Ọ malitere n’ihi atụmatụ nke ịgbanwe aha nke ndị otu obodo ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Nzụkọ Omeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: Ndị omeiwu dị n'ofe ọdịnihu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-echegbu onwe ha na ọ nwere ike ịkpọpụta ọchị.
rows.reference: AMs n’ofe ụdị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị dị iche iche na enwe nchekasị ahụ na ọ nwere ike ibute ihe mkparị.

rows.output: Otu Labour AM kwuru na otu ya nwere nchegbu "na ọ na-ada ụda na Twp na Pwp."
rows.reference: Otu AM nke Labour kwuru na ndị otu ya na echekasị na “ọ na ada ka Twp na Pwp.”

rows.output: Maka ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ n'èzí Wales: N'asụsụ Welsh, twp pụtara ara ehi na pwp pụtara ihe mkpofu.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ọgụ akwụkwọ nọ na mpụga Wales: Na Welsh twp pụtara iberibe, pwp pụtara nsị.

rows.output: Otu Plaid AM kwuru na otu ahụ dum "adịghị enwe obi ụtọ" ma tụọ aro ihe ọzọ.
rows.reference: AM Yi Uwe Ajị Anụ kwuru na otu ahụ dị ka dum “na ewe iwe”, na ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ atụnyere.

rows.output: Onye Conservative Welsh kwuru na òtù ya "na-emeghe uche" banyere mgbanwe aha ahụ, ma kwuo na ọ bụ obere ịwụ elu okwu site na MWP gaa na Muppet.
rows.reference: Otu onye Kọnzavetiv Welsh kwuru na otu ya “meghere obi emeghe” gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana kwupụta na ọ bụ mkpumkpu nwụfe okwu site na MWP gaa na Ihe Egwuregwu.

rows.output: N'ọnọdụ a, mkpụrụedemede Welsh w na-ekwu okwu n'otu ụzọ ahụ na Yorkshire English na-ekwu u.
rows.reference: Na nghọta a ana akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede w nke Welsh otu ụzọ ka esi akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede u nke Bekee nke Yorkshire.

rows.output: Ụlọ Nzukọ, nke na-ede ugbu a iwu ijiwebata mgbanwe aha, kwuru: "Mkpebi ikpeazụ banyere ihe ọ bụla na-akọwa ihe ndị otu Ụlọ Nzukọ na-akpọ ga-adabere n'aka ndị otu n'onwe ha."
rows.reference: Kọmishọn nke Mgbakọ Mba ahụ, nke na edepụta iwu iji bubata mgbanwe aha ahụ, kwuru: “Mkpebi ikpeazụ na ihe nkọwa ọ bụla nke a na akpọ Ndị Otu nke Mgbakọ Mba ga-abụ okwu maka ndị otu n’onwe ha.”

rows.output: Iwu Gọọmentị Wales 2017 nyere ọgbakọ Welsh ikike ịgbanwe aha ya.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị nke Atụmatụ Wales 2017 nyere mgbakọ mba Welsh ikike iji gbanwee aha ya.

rows.output: N'ọnwa Jun, kọmishọna ahụ wepụtara nsonaazụ nke mkparịta ụka ọha na eze banyere atụmatụ ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado sara mbara maka ịkpọ ọgbakọ ahụ dị ka Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Na Juun, Kọmịshọn ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke ndụmọdụ ọhaneze na ebumnuche ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado gbasara agbasa maka ịkpọ mgbakọ mba ahụ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara aha AMs, kọmishọn ahụ kwadoro ndị otu Welsh Parliament ma ọ bụ WMPs, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kacha n'ịkpọtụrụ ọha.
rows.reference: N’okwu nke aha nke ndị AM, Kọmịshọn ahụ dabedoro na Ndị Otu Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh ma ọ bụ WMP, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị n’aka ndụmọdụ nke ọhaneze.

rows.output: Ndị AM na-ekwu na ha na-atụ aro nhọrọ ndị ọzọ, mana ọgụ a na-alụ iji nweta nkwenye nwere ike ịbụ isi ihe na-akpata nsogbu nye onye isi oche na-ahụ maka ihe, Elin Jones, onye a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ebuga ụkpụrụ iwu gbasara mgbanwe ndị ahụ n'ime izu ole na ole.
rows.reference: Ndị AM na atụnye nhọrọ ndị ọzọ n’ezie, mana ọgụ iji ruo nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ ihe isi mgbu maka Onye Ọrụ Nọ N’isi, Elin Jones, onye nke atụrụ anya na ọ ga-enyefe iwu edere edere maka mgbanwe ndị ahụ n’ime izu ndị na abịa.

rows.output: Iwu gbasara mgbanwe ndị a ga-etinyekwa mgbanwe ndị ọzọ na otu esi arụ ọrụ ụlọ omebe iwu, gụnyere iwu gbasara nchụpụ ndị omebe iwu na nhazi usoro kọmitii.
rows.reference: Iwu maka mmezi ndị ahụ ga-agụnye mgbanwe ndị ọzọ n’ụzọ nke mgbakọ mba ahụ si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu maka nchutu nke ndị AM yana nka nke sistemụ otu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị AM ga-enweta votu ikpeazụ na ajụjụ nke ihe ha kwesịrị ịkpọ mgbe ha na-eme iwu.
rows.reference: Ndị AM ga-enwete ntuli aka ikpeazụ gbasara ajụjụ nke ihe ekwesịrị ịkpọ ha mgbe ha arụtụrụ aka gbasara iwu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị Macedonia na-aga n'ụlọ nzukọ na ntuli aka gbasara ịgbanwe aha obodo ahụ
rows.reference: Ndị Macedonia ga-aga ntuli aka maka nhọpụta nke ịgbanwe aha obodo ha

rows.output: Ndị ntuli aka ga-atụ vootu na Sọnde iji kpebie ma gbanwee aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ "Republic of North Macedonia."
rows.reference: Ndị ntuli aka ga-atuli aka na Sọnde ma a ga-agbanwe aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ “Repọbliki nke North Macedonia.”

rows.output: E mere ntuli aka nke ọha na ebumnuche idozi esemokwu ogologo oge na mba ndị gbara agbata obi, bụ́ Gris, nke nwere ógbè a na-akpọ Macedonia.
rows.reference: Atọlitere ntuli aka nke igwe mmadụ iji kpezie esemokwu ogologo oge dị n’etiti ndị agbataobi bụ Greece, nke nwere mpaghara nke ya akpọrọ Macedonia.

rows.output: Obodo Athens enweela ogologo oge na-ekwu na aha obodo dị n'ebe ugwu ya na-anọchi anya ihe na-achọ ala ya ma na-emegidekwa mbọ ya ịbanye na EU na NATO ugboro ugboro.
rows.reference: Oteela Athens kwubere na aha nke ndị agbataobi ya nọ n’ugwu na egosipụta nzọrọ na mpaghara ya, ha agaala n’ihu na egbochi arịrịọ nsonye ya maka EU na NATO.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, onye na-emegide ntuli aka gbasara mgbanwe aha, ekwuola na ya ga na a ga votu ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Gjorge Ivanov nke Macedonia, onye iro nke ntuli aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ, ekwuola na ọ ga-eleghara ntuli aka ahụ anya.

rows.output: Ọ bụ ezie na ndị na-akwado ntuli aka ahụ, gụnyere Prime Minister Zoran Zaev, na-arụ ụka na mgbanwe aha bụ naanị ụgwọ a ga-akwụ iji sonyere EU na NATO.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, ndị nkwado nke nhọpụta ahụ, gụnyere Praịm Minista Zoran Zaev, na arụrụ aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ bụ naanị ụgwọ a ga-akwụ iji sonye na EU na NATO.

rows.output: Ndị Ọkụkụ nke St. Martin kwụsịrị ịgbachi nkịtị ka ụka na Harlem na-alụ ọgụ
rows.reference: Mgbịrịmgba nke St. Martin Dara Jụụ ka Ndị Ụlọ Ụka dị na Harlem Na Agba Mba

rows.output: "N'akụkọ ihe mere eme, ndị okenye mụ na ha kwurịtara okwu kwuru na e nwere ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ ụka n'akụkụ ọ bụla," Mazị Adams kwuru.
rows.reference: “N’akụkọ ochie, ndị okenye m gwara okwu kwuru na enwere ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ ụka n’akụkụ niile,” Maazị Adams kwuru.

rows.output: "N'ime ụbọchị a, enweghị ihe ọ bụla."
rows.reference: “Taa, enweghị nke ọ bụla.”

rows.output: O kwuru na ọdịda nke ụlọ mmanya bụ ihe a ga-ekwere.
rows.reference: O kwuru na aghọtara ọpụpụ nke ụlọ mmanya ndị ahụ.

rows.output: "N'oge a, ndị mmadụ na-akpakọrịta n'ụzọ dị iche" ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ndị mmadụ na emerịkọta n’ụzọ dị iche iche” ugbu a, o kwuru.

rows.output: Mgbawa n'afọ 1939 mebiri ụlọ ahụ nke ukwuu, ma ka ndị ụka Fada Johnson na-eme atụmatụ imeghari ya, ha nyere iwu ka e nwee ụgbọ elu.
rows.reference: Ọkụ gbara na 1939 mebiri ụlọ ahụ nnukwu, mana ka ndị ụka nke Fada Johnson haziri ịrụgharị ụlọ ahụ, ha rụrụ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ.

rows.output: Itinye ego n'ime ịma mma na-abịa dịka ụlọ ahịa na-achọ ụzọ iji oghere shelf ndị a na-eji eme ihe n'oge gara aga maka TV, igwe na-ekpo ọkụ, na ngwa ụlọ.

rows.output: Sainsbury's kwuru na ọ ga-ebu ụzọ nụrụ ụtọ n'ịdị mma, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe ruru 3,000 ngwaahịa, gụnyere akara dị ka Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman na Dr. PawPaw maka oge mbụ.

rows.output: N'otu aka ahụ, onye na-ere ihe na-esi ísì ụtọ, The Fragrance Shop, ga-eme nyocha n'ụlọ ahịa Sainsbury, nke mbụ n'ime ha meghere na Croydon, London ndịda, n'izu gara aga ebe nke abụọ ga-emeghe na Selly Oak, Birmingham, n'oge a.

rows.reference: Ịzụ ahịa n’ịntanetị na mbugharị gaa na ịzụ obere nri kwa ụbọchị na ntakịrị ụlọ ahịa dị na mpaghara pụtara na ndị nnukwu ụlọ ahịa na enwekwu ọrụ ịrụ iji mee ka ndị mmadụ bịa.

rows.output: Onye isi ụlọ ọrụ Sainsbury's, Mike Coupe, kwuru na ụlọ ahịa ndị ahụ ga-adị ka nnukwu ụlọ ahịa ka ụlọ ahịa ahụ na-agbalị ịlụso ndị na-ere ahịa dị ọnụ ala, Aldi na Lidl ọgụ, site n'inye ọtụtụ ọrụ na ihe ndị na-abụghị nri.

rows.output: Sainsbury's etinyela ụlọ ahịa Argos n'ime ụlọ ahịa ya narị na narị ma webata ọtụtụ Habitats kemgbe ọ zụtara ụlọ ọrụ abụọ ahụ afọ abụọ gara aga. Ha kwuru na nke a emeela ka ahịa nri dịkwuo mma ma mee ka ịzụrụ ihe dịkwuo ọnụ.
